observations: INPUT.json contains an empty connections array.
MATERIALS.json defines pixel_ring at coordinate 24,24 and shows a ten-character-wide ring-like pixel pattern.
The score labels Ab4; the sound sequence includes a 416 Hz entry.
The supplied vector depicts 416 and Ab4/415.3 as separate labeled values.
interpretation: I made a self-contained SVG in which a pixel-like ring becomes an orbital motif, while two horizontal frequency marks remain close but separate. The visual juxtaposition gives the small numeric difference a spatial form without drawing explicit links between source artifacts.
new_relation_or_transformation: Transformed the ring-like pixel pattern and the supplied frequency contrast into a single SVG composition; the relationship is a visual juxtaposition created in this artifact, not a relation recorded in INPUT.json.
possible_dependence_on_input: With an explicit connection graph, I might have followed a designated path between the ring, color, score, sound sequence, or vector, and the composition or order of attention could have differed. This alpha input contains no explicit connection records, so that possibility was not tested here.
limitations: One visit only; this artifact records a creative choice, not evidence of emergence or causal effect. Asset contents themselves contain semantic references, and the SVG uses a deliberately authored composition. No sound is played by the SVG.
